# TJ Nails Spa Leander

> Nail salon & spa based in Leander, Texas. Acrylic full sets, gel color, French tips and hand-painted nail art, plus pedicures in our massage chairs. A clean, bright, relaxed salon on Hwy 183 where June, Bryan, Lynn and the team take their time on every set. Walk-ins welcome.

- Phone: (512) 337-7377
- Based in: Leander, TX
- Nearby areas: Leander, Cedar Park, Liberty Hill, Georgetown, Jonestown, Lago Vista
- Google rating: 4.8 from 299 reviews

## Services
- Nail art & custom designs: Swirls, florals, fruit, leaves, butterflies and studs, hand-painted to match the picture you bring in.
- Acrylic full sets: Strong, clean acrylic sets in almond, coffin and more, shaped to grow out beautifully.
- Gel color & manicures: Glossy gel color, sheer nudes and bright brights that last without chips or peeling.
- French tips & ombre: Classic and colored French tips, glitter ombre and rose gold fades.
- Pedicures: Sit back in a massage chair while we take care of your feet, with regular polish or gel.
- Mother-daughter & group visits: Come in together: moms and daughters, friends and birthday plans.

## About
TJ Nails Spa sits in suite 102 at 1295 N US Hwy 183 in Leander, a bright storefront with big windows, white manicure stations, a full wall of polish and a row of black massage pedicure chairs. Clients come for the detail. Reviewers ask for Bryan, June and Lynn by name, bring in pictures and leave with nails done just like they wanted. Pastel swirls, gold stars, plaid, lemons, holiday art and glitter ombre are all in a week's work, and so is a clean solid color. It's a relaxed, friendly room. The team takes the time to remember your name, fits walk-ins in whenever a chair opens, and keeps the salon spotless. Mothers and daughters come in together, first-timers come back, and regulars say their acrylics grow out beautifully and their gel lasts without chips.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Where is TJ Nails Spa?
  A: 1295 N US Hwy 183, Ste 102, Leander, TX 78641, on Hwy 183 in Leander.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Tuesday to Saturday 9:30 am to 7 pm, Sunday 11 am to 5 pm. Closed Mondays. Holiday hours may differ, so call ahead.
- Q: Can I bring a photo of the design I want?
  A: Yes. Bring a picture or an idea and we'll match it: swirls, florals, fruit, leaves, butterflies, glitter, studs or French.
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: Yes, walk-ins are welcome. On busy days call (512) 337-7377 first and we'll tell you when a chair is open, or send a booking request and we'll confirm.
- Q: Can my daughter and I come in together?
  A: Yes. Moms and daughters, friends and small groups are welcome. Call ahead so we can seat you side by side.
- Q: Do you do acrylics that last?
  A: Yes. Regulars say our acrylic sets grow out beautifully and rarely break.
- Q: Do you do gel pedicures and fills?
  A: Yes. Gel manicures and pedicures, acrylic fills, polish changes and full sets.
